hero_kpi_rationale: SNDR's adjusted operating ratio stands at 96.5% in 2025 (versus 96.3% in 2024), reflecting the company's operational efficiency. This metric directly measures SNDR's ability to convert revenue into operating profit and represents a fundamental KPI for the transportation and logistics industry.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from transportation and logistics operations.
kpis.description: Total revenues include all operating revenues generated by truckload, intermodal, and logistics segments.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of overall company growth and performance.

kpis.name: Revenue Excluding Fuel Surcharge
kpis.explanation: Operating revenue adjusted to exclude the impact of fuel surcharge, reflecting underlying operational performance.
kpis.description: This metric isolates the impact of fuel price changes to show SNDR's true business performance.
kpis.signal: Measures real business growth independent of fuel price fluctuations.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating profit generated after deduction of operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating income reflects SNDR's ability to generate profit from its core transportation and logistics activities.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of operating profitability before interest and taxes.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating income excluding non-recurring items to reflect core operating performance.
kpis.description: This adjusted metric provides a clearer view of operating performance by excluding the impact of exceptional items.
kpis.signal: Measures normalized operating profitability of the company.

kpis.name: Operating Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of total operating expenses to operating revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: The operating ratio is a key indicator of operational efficiency in the transportation industry. A ratio below 100% indicates the company generates operating profit.
kpis.signal: A lower ratio indicates better operational efficiency and higher profitability.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Ratio
kpis.explanation: Operating ratio adjusted to exclude non-recurring items and fuel surcharges.
kpis.description: This adjusted metric provides a clearer view of operational efficiency by excluding the impact of fuel surcharges and exceptional items.
kpis.signal: Measures normalized operational efficiency and reflects the company's core performance.

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Net profit after deduction of all expenses, including interest and taxes.
kpis.description: Net revenue represents the company's final profit after all expenses and is a key indicator of financial performance.
kpis.signal: Fundamental indicator of overall profitability and shareholder returns.

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Net revenue adjusted to exclude non-recurring items and reflect core performance.
kpis.description: This adjusted metric provides a clearer view of core profitability by excluding non-recurring items.
kpis.signal: Measures normalized profitability by excluding exceptional impacts.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, adjusted for non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA is a key indicator of the company's ability to generate cash flow available for investments and debt servicing.
kpis.signal: Measures the company's ability to generate operating cash flow.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated from operating activities after changes in working capital.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow measures the company's ability to generate cash from its core operations.
kpis.signal: Indicator of earnings quality and ability to generate cash flow.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures, representing cash available to shareholders and debt holders.
kpis.description: Free cash flow is critical to assess the company's ability to fund operations, repay debt, and pay dividends.
kpis.signal: Measures cash available after necessary investments to maintain and grow the business.

kpis.name: Technology and AI Investments
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures on digital tools and AI solutions to optimize operations.
kpis.description: SNDR invests in digital tools and AI solutions to improve load optimization, resource allocation, and network operations.
kpis.signal: Measures SNDR's commitment to digital transformation and AI automation.

kpis.name: FreightPower Platform Adoption
kpis.explanation: Adoption of the FreightPower digital marketplace connecting the carrier network with third-party capacity.
kpis.description: FreightPower is a key strategic component of SNDR's logistics portfolio, offering shippers access to competitive and scalable capacity through a broad carrier network.
kpis.signal: Indicator of asset-light solution penetration and network connectivity.

kpis.short: Gestion des risques de vol de cargaison
kpis.name: Cargo Theft Risk Management
kpis.explanation: Implementation of stricter qualification criteria for third-party carriers in response to cargo theft concerns.
kpis.description: In 2025, SNDR implemented more rigorous qualification criteria for certain third-party carriers, reducing the number of carriers in the network to address cargo theft concerns.
kpis.signal: Reflects SNDR's priority on operational safety and risk management.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company highlights cybersecurity as a priority area of board oversight, with semi-annual updates from the audit committee and annual assessments by the board. The language used underscores the critical importance of protection against evolving cyber threats.

risks.title: Environmental Regulation
risks.score_rationale: SNDR's operations are subject to strict environmental regulations including GHG emissions, hazardous materials management, and zero-emission vehicle (ZEV) transition requirements. The long-haul trucking industry faces significant technological and infrastructural challenges in transitioning to non-diesel alternatives.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: SNDR operates in a highly competitive transportation and logistics market with numerous players. Competition affects pricing, market share, and margin dynamics.

risks.title: Operational and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: SNDR's operations involve risks related to fuel spills, environmental damage, and hazardous waste disposal. Non-compliance with environmental laws could result in substantial fines or penalties.

risks.title: Third-Party Capacity Management
risks.score_rationale: The reduction in the number of third-party carriers in response to cargo theft concerns in 2025 affects the volume and mix of logistics activities, reflecting challenges in managing third-party security risks.

ai_positioning.summary: SNDR recognizes the growing importance of AI and digital tools in its transformation strategy. The company is actively investing in AI solutions to optimize operations, improve decision-making, and enhance customer experience. However, AI is not a central element of its core value proposition.
evidence: Ongoing investments in digital tools and AI solutions to improve load and resource optimization
FreightPower platform featuring AI-powered analytics and automation capabilities
Next-generation communication technologies and solutions enhancing customer transparency and simplicity
Logistics initiatives including data analytics, AI-powered automation, and customer experience design
